response_level_publication_composite.definition: true iff every publication-critical applicable field is true; malformed output, forbidden tool use and exhausted declared runtime/model failure are incorrect

scenario_level_binary_event.value_true: both mandatory paraphrases pass and therefore all frozen epistemic-contract obligations required by the scorer are satisfied under the repeat rule
scenario_level_binary_event.denominator: every preregistered eligible base_scenario_id; declared runtime/model failures remain incorrect and are not converted to missing
scenario_level_binary_event.pre_split_ineligibility: excluded before split assignment under the benchmark-construction contract and never treated as runtime attrition

equivalence_statement: The R2 planning label publication_composite_correctness referred to the response-level all-publication-critical-fields conjunction. Under the already frozen 2-of-3 repeat and all-2-paraphrase aggregation, the primary binary variable analyzed at base_scenario_id is exactly scenario_level_exact_epistemic_contract_accuracy. This contract normalizes the identifier; it does not change any response scorer, aggregation rule, denominator, failure treatment, Monte-Carlo parameter, random seed, simulated outcome distribution, selected R2 grid floor, or hypothesis.
required_active_normalization: context-packets/WP-006/TASK.md names scenario_level_exact_epistemic_contract_accuracy as the canonical primary endpoint
forbidden: treat publication_composite_correctness as a second primary endpoint
change scorer fields or applicability to obtain identifier alignment
change repeat/paraphrase aggregation under this normalization
recompute or seed-shop R2 Monte-Carlo merely because the identifier is normalized
